title: General anesthetics decouple the apical from the somatic compartment

statements.text: Several anesthetic agents functionally decouple the two compartments of layer 5 pyramidal neurons: the neurons stay intact and fire action potentials, but top-down input to the apical dendrites no longer influences their output. The finding is from rodents.

sources.quote: it has been demonstrated that various different anesthetic agents
lead to functional decoupling between the two compartments
Loss of consciousness due to anesthesia correlates with a decoupling of the apical from the basal dendrites in these neurons.
